description: Milestone 3 Steps 7-9 screening thresholds and service reallocation rules across Aug-Oct 2026 observed typical days (split by weekday and weekend day groups).

step7_9_review_window.data_source: observed_typical_days (matched_hourly Aug-Sep + cleaned Oct 2026 with active GTFS 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-17)
step7_9_review_window.dates_summary: 92 calendar days -> 90 typical days: 63 typical weekdays and 27 typical weekend days

fewer_trips_screening.note: Targets observed typical (route, day_group, time_band) cells with <= 22.0 riders/svc-hr, <= 15.0% hours above p75, >= 20 active days, and >= 2.0 avg trips/day.

more_trips_screening.note: Targets observed typical (route, day_group, time_band) cells with >= 40.0 riders/svc-hr, >= 65.0% hours above p75, >= 20 active days, and >= 2.0 avg trips/day (excluding M35 outlier).

coverage_guardrails.note: Routes serving >=60% exclusive stops cannot be discontinued or deeply cut without losing unique street coverage; cap trims at -10%.

shared_corridor_overlap.note: Merge feasibility checks apply strictly to shared_corridor pairs (>=40% overlap share) and exclude same_family variants (M15/M15+, M34+/M34A+, M14A+/M14D+).

step8_9_adjustment_rules.demand_assumption_statement: Assumes total ridership stays constant when scheduled trips change (+/-10% or +/-20%), isolating arithmetic changes in riders per trip, riders per service-hour, and hours exceeding the high-demand threshold.
